title.narrative: Green and Inclusive Growth for Sustainable Development

description.narrative: The Project offers programming solutions to support SMEs private sector job creation, help companies to remain active but also help vulnerable groups, including Roma, persons with disabilities, women, youth and long-term unemployed, to find their place in the open labour market. Through inclusive entrepreneurship approach, it will provide support to all target groups including those that are in some way disadvantaged in creation of sustainable businesses in the market. In addition, the Project will tackle economic reintegration of long-term unemployed and will offer possibilities to the local authorities for co-designing community based social services, needed for broader inclusion of vulnerable people in the society. Operational Employment Plan 2024 continues with Care Economy, through implementation of community measures in this very challenging area of work through support to municipalities and service providers in the community. Measure also envisages complex set of support for creation of new services NGOs or new service line within the licensed private entities that are interested in delivering these services on a commercial basis.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
